disposition_reason: 72 market samples of four pepper types from six Osogbo markets analysed for six metals by flame AAS; means per pepper type and market.

study.design: market survey, 6 markets x 4 pepper types x 3 sales points (72 samples)
study.market: Ota-Efun, Oja-Oba, Igbona, Orisunbare, Olu-Ode and Shasha markets, Osogbo, Osun State, Nigeria
study.method: wet digestion (H2O2, H2SO4, HNO3, perchloric acid) and flame AAS (Buck 210/211 VGP) after washing, oven-drying at 80 C and grinding
study.qa: blank and calibration standards; duplicate analysis; no CRM or recovery

controls.outcome: Shasha market means lowest for all six metals: Cd 0.00925 vs 0.0135-0.0190 ppm; Pb 0.0030 vs 0.00475-0.00725 ppm (Table 2, significant by DMRT)

regulatory_or_exposure.what: FAO/WHO 2012 limits quoted for leafy and fruiting vegetables

unresolved: Per-market Min/Max rows in Table 1 restate the pepper-type means and were not recorded separately.
Detection limits not reported; several cadmium and lead means (0.002-0.009 ppm) are near or below typical flame AAS capability for a 0.5 g/50 mL digest.
